title: Worth the $$
text: Worth the $$. Okay... I'm reorganizing a closet room and I needed a way to sort through some things without killing my back... (old and blonde)... I have one of the single rod version that folds flat... these will.. but you have to dissemble them pretty substantially.  Plus the single rod version has these little couplers that hold the rod when it's flat.. these do not. They also do not adjust in height.. but they are plenty tall enough to hang longer items.  I did double wrap a couple of my longer dresses. The double rod, of course, doubles your hanging space.  However, all of that being said, took me about 8 minutes to put each one together, by myself. They come with a little, flat wrench.  I tape those to the bottom of the racks when I'm done so I always have the right tool to dissemble when ready.  The ends to extend as described.  The wheels are are quite heavy duty and "drive" the racks easily.  They will be handy to use in a garage sale, or whenever I think I need to reorganize again.  The price is right for the quality, they arrived quickly and in good condition, I have prime.  I always update if there are any wear or other issues. Quick note: Included with the instruction page was a card that notes they are covered by a lifetime warranty.  I saved that in a bag with the wrench and taped to the bottom of one rack.
